feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report placeholder with no features.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Contains prewritten summaries of all frontend source files for reference.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base styles defining OKLCH color tokens, dark theme variants, and global border/background rules.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point mounting the React app and loading main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React component assembling layout, handling category hover/selection, and rendering VinylPlayer, HDDHub, and CategoryOverlay.
frontend/src/components/CategoryModal.ts: Empty file placeholder for a category modal component.
Glass-morphism overlay panel showing category details with escape handling, backdrop, and scrollable content sections.
frontend/src/components/HDDHub.tsx: Interactive HDD visualization mapping categories to arm rotation lanes with image fallbacks and disk spin animation.
frontend/src/components/PortfolioShell.t: Page wrapper that preloads a background image with fallback chain and renders dimmed full-screen background.
frontend/src/components/VinylPlayer.tsx: Vinyl player with play/pause control, rotating vinyl image, audio loop, and fallback asset handling.
frontend/src/data/categories.ts: Defines a Category interface and exports a list of category objects used for site sections.
frontend/src/data/categoryOverlayContent: Provides structured overlay content for each category, including photo metadata and text sections.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor based on Internet Identity, refetching dependent queries when identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements an Internet Identity context and provider handling auth client setup, login, and stored identity loading.
frontend/src/index.css: Sets global Tailwind layers, theme variables, and custom utility classes including glass and animation styles.
frontend/src/lib/assetFallbacks.ts: Defines fallback chains for various images and includes a function to generate inline SVG placeholders.
frontend/src/lib/assetUrls.ts: Provides base-path–safe asset URL resolution and exports canonical asset paths.
frontend/src/lib/utils.ts: Exports a utility function combining clsx and tailwind-merge for className merging.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with QueryClient and InternetIdentity providers before rendering App.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind with custom OKLCH color variables, extended animations, typography, and container settings, plus plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
frontend/vite.config.ts: Sets up Vite for a React project with env loading, API proxying, custom aliases, and esbuild global definitions.
project_state.json: Stores the project’s versioned state describing a React-based portfolio site layout, interactions, assets, and known issues with the HDD hub and animations.
